name: Nocturne
description: A square-shouldered eau de parfum bottle in smoked dark-grey faceted glass, topped with a matte black cap, with clean geometric facets catching light along its edges.
materials: smoked dark-grey faceted glass, matte black cap
primaryColors: smoked charcoal grey, matte black, silver
negativeConstraints: Never render any text, logo, wordmark, label, or embossed lettering anywhere on the bottle or cap; never add a printed or foil label to the glass; never tint the glass clear or any color other than smoked charcoal grey; never render a second cap. Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: Keep the smoked charcoal-grey glass tone and exact faceting pattern (number, angle, and placement of facets) identical across every angle; keep the matte black cap's flat-topped cylindrical shape and matte, non-glossy finish consistent in every shot; the glass must remain completely unmarked, no text or emblem on any face. When the art direction explicitly names a mark on this product, that named mark is part of the product's identity for that shot and overrides the blank-surface requirement.
